title: Kairelite's Tabby Replacer
description: A resource pack that replaces the default tabby cat with a grey one, based on my own cat!
body:
Just a simple resource pack that replaces the default tabby cat rexture with a grey longhaired one inspired by my own cat!

Yes, the orange eye is real, it's iris melanosis. If your pet's eye changes colour suddenly, please take them to a vet, since there's a possibility of these cells being cancerous.
